<!-- JForm: Google reCAPTCHA runs here, outside the Lightning Web Security sandbox; the form renderer asks for it and for tokens by postMessage -->
<script>(function(){var loading=false,key=null,KEY=/^[\w-]{10,100}$/;function load(k){if(loading)return;loading=true;key=k;var s=document.createElement("script");s.src="https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js?render="+encodeURIComponent(k);s.async=true;document.head.appendChild(s);}function reply(id,token,error){window.postMessage({type:"jform:captcha:token",requestId:id,token:token||null,error:error||null},window.location.origin);}window.addEventListener("message",function(e){var m=e.data;if(!m||typeof m!=="object"||e.origin!==window.location.origin)return;if(m.type==="jform:captcha"&&typeof m.siteKey==="string"&&KEY.test(m.siteKey)){load(m.siteKey);return;}if(m.type!=="jform:captcha:execute"||typeof m.requestId!=="string")return;var k=typeof m.siteKey==="string"&&KEY.test(m.siteKey)?m.siteKey:key;if(!k){reply(m.requestId,null,"no site key");return;}if(!loading)load(k);var tries=0;(function wait(){var g=window.grecaptcha;if(g&&g.ready){g.ready(function(){try{g.execute(k,{action:typeof m.action==="string"?m.action:"jform_submit"}).then(function(t){reply(m.requestId,t);},function(err){reply(m.requestId,null,String(err));});}catch(err){reply(m.requestId,null,String(err));}});}else if(tries++<40){setTimeout(wait,250);}else{reply(m.requestId,null,"recaptcha not loaded");}})();});})();</script>
